groups.operation: Call ucl_parser_free before returning from a failed ucl_parser_add_string call.
groups.capability: Release the parser and its owned state with ucl_parser_free.
groups.consequence: The parser and its owned state remain allocated.
groups.equivalence_reason: All five describe the same error-branch cleanup obligation; they differ in how confidently they establish a reachable error.

groups.operation: Construct the string parser with UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS enabled.
groups.condition: Input comments are parsed through the supported saved-comment mode.
groups.capability: Save and attach comments during string parsing.
groups.consequence: The harness cannot exercise saved-comment behavior.
groups.equivalence_reason: Each identifies the fixed zero flags passed to ucl_parser_new as the obstacle to the same parser mode.

groups.operation: Clean up an orphan parser->last_comment in ucl_state_machine or ucl_parser_free.
groups.condition: A saved comment remains orphaned when parsing ends or the parser is freed.
groups.capability: Release the orphan comment through the applicable cleanup path.
groups.equivalence_reason: This candidate spans terminal parsing and parser destruction, so its trigger and operation do not exactly match the narrower destructor candidates.

groups.operation: Release a terminal orphan parser->last_comment and subsequently call ucl_parser_free.
groups.condition: The terminal path has already released the comment.
groups.capability: Prevent a second ucl_object_unref of the released comment.
groups.consequence: A second release could corrupt memory.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both address duplicate release of the same terminal orphan during later parser destruction.

groups.operation: Call ucl_parser_free after a parse error with parser->last_comment pending.
groups.condition: UCL_PARSER_SAVE_COMMENTS is enabled, a comment remains pending, and parsing reports an error.
groups.consequence: The pending saved comment remains allocated.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both require error-path destruction specifically to reach the new pending-comment cleanup.

groups.condition: Parser destruction occurs while a saved, unattached last_comment remains set.
groups.capability: Call ucl_object_unref on the pending comment during destruction.
groups.consequence: The pending comment remains allocated after parser destruction.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both describe the destructor's conditional release; neither requires a parse error as its trigger.
